###
Reducto uses per-product pricing based on what you process. Standard rates start at $1 per 1,000 pages for r-1 mini Parse, $10 per 1,000 pages for r-1 Parse, and $20 per 1,000 pages for Extract, with parsing included. Standard accounts include $150 in free credits.

title: Reducto vs Extend | Agentic Document Platform Compared
snippet:
Migration credits
If you're using another document processor, we'll give you up to $5,000 in credits to migrate your workload to Reducto.
[Apply for migration credits](https://reducto.ai/migrate)

| Pricing | From $0.01/page pay-as-you-go; $150 in free credits. | PAYG: 10,000 free credits, then $0.01/credit; no monthly minimum.

- **Pricing structure** Extend offers pay-as-you-go with 10,000 free credits, then $0.01 per credit, with no monthly minimum. Cost per page depends on the processor and mode. Reducto [starts at $0.01/page pay-as-you-go](https://docs.reducto.ai/reference/credit-usage) for Parse r-1 with $150 in free credits (enough to run a real evaluation before spending anything) and scales into custom volume discounts. One platform covers parse, extract, split, classify, and edit, with per-product pricing and parsing included with Extract and Deep Extract.
